title: wt session list --json
description: The agent sessions in a worktree, in every worktree of the repository, or with --all, --roots or --profile in every selected repository. Printed by `wt session list [<work>] --json` as the only thing on stdout; it writes nothing to any session. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

sessions.description: The worktree's sessions, the one that needs its person first and then the newest, the session wt runs under last.

sessionsError.description: Why claude's sessions could not be read (claude is not on the PATH, it did not answer). The sessions are then empty and the exit status is 1.

error.description: Why the worktree could not be found, or is ambiguous.

codexError.description: Why Codex's sessions could not be looked for (the process table, its logs). The Claude sessions are listed regardless.

session.description: One agent session in a worktree, as wt list's SESSION column knows it, with where a message to it would go.

kind.description: Whose session. A Codex session has no sessionId, no inbox and no transcript; its state is busy or idle.

id.description: The short id claude attach takes; null for a session open only in a terminal.

sessionId.description: The conversation's full id: what --expect-session takes.

name.description: The name the session goes by, cleaned of control characters; null when it has none.

pid.description: Claude's process; null for a session with none, a parked background one.

terminal.description: An interactive session, open in a terminal; false for a background one, even while attached.

state.description: As everywhere in wt: idle is a session waiting for its person; anything else, and anything not known to be idle, is busy.

claudeState.description: claude agents --json's state (working, blocked, done, failed, stopped), raw; null for a session with none.

claudeStatus.description: claude agents --json's status (busy, waiting, idle), raw; null while it has no process.

waitingFor.description: What a waiting session waits on (permission prompt, input needed), raw; null unless it is.

inbox.description: The inbox's socket, as uds: without the prefix: an absolute path. Null when inboxUnavailable says why.

inboxUnavailable.description: Why there is no inbox. notRunning: no process. own: the session wt runs under; wt does not send to it. codex: a Codex session takes no messages. noRegistry: claude's registry file for the pid is missing, unreadable, or names another session. notASocket: the path is not a socket of yours in a directory closed to others. refused: it did not accept a connection.

transcript.description: The session's transcript file, when one is found.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339, UTC, from claude agents --json's startedAt; null when it has none.

lastActivityAt.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the modification time of the transcript file, one stat and no read, so it is there for a parked session too. Claude writes the transcript at every turn. Null when no transcript was found; never guessed.

activity.description: The one state word wt list and gittree agree on. parked: a background session with no process, whatever it was waiting for. needsInput: it has a process and is blocked or waiting on a prompt (waitingFor says which). done: claude's done, failed and stopped (claudeState has the raw word). working and idle as state busy and idle. A Codex session is working or idle.

background.description: A claude --bg session, which has an attach id, whether or not it is open in a terminal now; false for one started in a terminal.

shown.description: The session wt list shows for its worktree.

repo.description: The repository's name; empty when it is not known.

stateSince.description: RFC 3339, UTC: when claude last changed the session's status, from statusUpdatedAt in its registry file ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json. Null for a session with no process, or no registry file.
